abstract: In a prospective study a total of 65 patients in clinical stages IIA and IIB nonseminomatous testicular tumours were treated by primary chemotherapy followed by retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in cases with residual disease. The patients were given a combination of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin, or also etoposide. Sixty-two patients (95.4%) achieved complete response: 39 (60%) by chemotherapy alone and 23 (35.4%) following surgical removal of residual disease. Three patients died; there were two drug-related deaths during PVB chemotherapy, one patient had progression of disease following chemotherapy and died as a result of disease dissemination. Three patients relapsed from complete response following chemotherapy, two of them died within 19 and 29 months after the onset of therapy. The third patient received second-line chemotherapy and gained complete response again. Of the 65 patients, 60 (92.3%) survive with no evidence of disease. The follow-up period ranged from 6 to 79 months (mean 39.4 months, median 39 months).
abstract_ja: 前向き研究として、臨床病期IIA/IIBの非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍65例を、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン(PVB)を用いた初回化学療法の対象とした。一部の症例ではエトポシドを併用した。残存病変を有する症例には、その後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。62例(95.4%)が完全寛解を達成し、このうち39例(60%)は化学療法のみで、23例(35.4%)は残存病変の外科的切除後に達成した。死亡は3例で、そのうち2例はPVB化学療法中の薬剤関連死、1例は化学療法後に病勢が進行して死亡した。完全寛解後に再発した症例は3例で、うち2例は再発後19ヶ月および29ヶ月で死亡した。3例目は二次化学療法を受け、再び完全寛解を達成した。65例中60例(92.3%)が無病生存しており、フォローアップ期間は6～79か月(平均39.4か月、中央値39か月)であった。
